_README: SR2026 DELTA for ai_knowledge_base.json. Add ONLY entries that are NEW or CHANGED vs the SR2025 base. This file overlays the base (app/resources/KB/ai_knowledge_base.json) ONLY when the fix request carries x-sr-version: SR2026. Merge rules: nested dicts merge key-by-key (so you can override a single field); scalars and LISTS replace. Top-level keys are either error codes (with root_cause / fix / affected_tags), or KB sections like field_constraints / tag_templates / dummy_data. Anything not present here is inherited from SR2025. Keys starting with '_' (like this one) are ignored by lookups. Example of a NEW SR2026-only error code is shown below under _EXAMPLE — copy it up to the top level (without the _EXAMPLE wrapper) and rename to the real code to activate.

SR2026_NEW_RULE_CODE.root_cause: Describe what triggers this SR2026 delta-rule error.
SR2026_NEW_RULE_CODE.fix: Describe the deterministic fix the suggester should apply.

DUPLICATE_XML_DECLARATION.root_cause: The <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> processing instruction appears more than once. XML 1.0 allows exactly one declaration, at the very start of the document. Usually caused by pasting a full message on top of an existing one.
DUPLICATE_XML_DECLARATION.fix: Remove every <?xml ...?> line from the document, then prepend exactly one: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> as the first line. All BusMsgEnvlp/AppHdr/Document content is unchanged.
DUPLICATE_XML_DECLARATION.do_not: Do NOT remove any part of the message body. Only the extra XML declaration line(s) must be deleted.

NBOFTXS_INVALID_CODE.root_cause: The schema validator misreports GrpHdr/NbOfTxs as an enumerated code field, producing 'Invalid code '<n>' for field 'NbOfTxs'.' even though NbOfTxs is a plain transaction count, not a code list.
NBOFTXS_INVALID_CODE.fix: Set GrpHdr/NbOfTxs to '1'. Every generated SR2026 message is single-transaction, so this is always 1 regardless of the reported invalid value — do not attempt to re-count transaction blocks for this specific error.

UNEXPECTED_FIELD_REMOVE.root_cause: The validator reports 'Unexpected field X' because that element is not defined in the current message type's XSD schema at that location, and no mandatory predecessor is missing. Common cases: <NbOfTxs> appears inside a pacs.002 GrpHdr (it belongs in pacs.003/pacs.008 GrpHdr, not pacs.002); <FIToFICstmrDrctDbt> (the pacs.003 Document root element) appears inside a pacs.002 Document.
UNEXPECTED_FIELD_REMOVE.fix: Remove the unexpected element entirely from its parent. Do NOT move it elsewhere. Example: remove <NbOfTxs> from pacs.002 GrpHdr; remove <FIToFICstmrDrctDbt> from a pacs.002 Document.

INVALID_BIZ_SVC.root_cause: AppHdr/BizSvc carries an SR2025-or-earlier CBPR+ business service identifier (e.g. swift.cbprplus.02 or swift.cbprplus.03 / .adv.03 / .cov.03). SR2026 moved CBPR+ onto the '.04' generation, but the exact value is per message type — it must match what the SR2026 delta-validator enforces.
INVALID_BIZ_SVC.fix: Set AppHdr/BizSvc to the SR2026 value for this message: 'swift.cbprplus.04' for pacs.008/002/004, pain.001/002, camt.052/053/054/056/057 and pacs.009 CORE; 'swift.cbprplus.adv.04' for pacs.009 ADV; 'swift.cbprplus.cov.04' for pacs.009 COV; 'swift.cbprplus.03' for pacs.003, pain.008 and camt.055.

BizSvc.notes: SR2026 CBPR+ values are per message type (must match the SR2026 delta-validators): swift.cbprplus.04 for pacs.008/002/004, pain.001/002, camt.052/053/054/056/057 and pacs.009 CORE; swift.cbprplus.adv.04 / swift.cbprplus.cov.04 for pacs.009 ADV / COV; swift.cbprplus.03 for pacs.003, pain.008 and camt.055. The SR2023/24 value swift.cbprplus.02 is never valid in SR2026.

BizSvc._note: SR2026 per-message CBPR+ business service. Most types use 'swift.cbprplus.04'; camt.055 (and pacs.003 / pain.008) stay on 'swift.cbprplus.03'; pacs.009 ADV/COV use 'swift.cbprplus.adv.04' / '.cov.04'. Never emit '.02' in SR2026.
